truth.title: globally-installable-npm-package
truth.contents: truths is published as an npm package that can be installed globally. It exposes two bin scripts: "truths" (an umbrella CLI built with commander) and "truths-server" (a shortcut that launches the HTTP server).
truth.notes: The prebuilt frontend ships inside the package so no build step runs on the user's machine.

truth.title: frontend-react-vite
truth.contents: The frontend is a React single-page app written in TypeScript and built with Vite. The build output goes to dist/, which the server serves as static assets.

truth.title: backend-express-server
truth.contents: The backend is a JavaScript (ESM) Express server. It lists truths.xml / truths-*.xml files in the current folder and exposes a small JSON API to read and save them. It starts on port 3000 and advances to the next free port if busy.
truth.notes: Port selection uses the get-port package; the browser is opened automatically on start.

truth.title: truths-stored-as-xml
truth.contents: Each truths file is XML: a root element wrapping a list of truth entries, each with a title, createdBy, approvedBy, contents, relatesTo, notes, and labels. The editor uses fast-xml-parser to round-trip between the XML and the structured form.

truth.title: linting-with-eslint-config-ironplate
truth.contents: Code quality is enforced with ESLint using eslint-config-ironplate: the node.js preset for the backend JavaScript and the react-typescript preset for the frontend TypeScript, scoped by directory.
